overall.verdict: A visually disciplined dark fintech wallet whose standout ideas — the one absolute pixel scale, the green-yours/violet-promise color semantics, and per-frame signed proof on every payment — are genuinely differentiating and legible. It loses points because those ideas are explained in Settings instead of at point of use, several flows bury their primary action or show disabled buttons without reasons, and protocol jargon (entity id, lazy board, prepare incoming account, capacity) leaks into first-touch screens.
priority_fixes: Promote 'WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS' (yours vs hub-promise split) and the green/violet legend from Manage/Settings onto the Home hero and Account headers so the core trust model is visible where money is first seen
Fix every dead-end primary action: disable with a reason and collapse fallbacks (12-assets-bottom receive flow, 13-lend pool offer, 0.00-balance Move into reserve)

Deduplicate and translate receive-side jargon: one 'Copy payment request' action, human-readable 'Your hub H1 can receive up to 45.50 instantly' instead of 'Prepare incoming account', entity id behind a disclosure
Make proof actionable everywhere: tap-to-copy Frame/Proof fields, a Share/forward receipt button on 08-activity-detail, and a sticky 'Save evidence bundle' on Sovereignty
Separate destructive and risk actions: move Dispute out of the account action grid, space Reveal-recovery-phrase from Forget-vault, and strengthen selected-tile state on Move

personas.name: Maya
personas.verdict: I could pay my friend from the big Pay button and the PAID screen with a green check felt amazing, but half the words on the way there meant nothing to me.
blockers: 02-pay: 'Route You → H1 → H2', 'Delivery Instant · Change', and a 42-hex address for the recipient — no plain-language confirmation of who she is paying
04-receive: 'Prepare incoming account' and 'capacity' jargon on the very screen a newcomer hits first to get money in
Home: 'Hub promise $122.99' is most of her balance, and nothing on 01-home tells her in plain words what happens if the hub vanishes (that explanation only exists on Manage/Sovereignty)

personas.name: Tomasz
personas.verdict: Credit vs collateral in the lane rows plus the green/violet bars is the clearest channel-risk picture I've seen outside a node CLI; I got my answer in well under 30 seconds.
blockers: 06-account: 'at risk' appears in the color legend but no element on the screen is explicitly labeled at-risk amount — I inferred it from the violet bar segment
15-sovereignty: challenge window ('they answer in 1 d') shows per counterparty, but there is no live countdown or dispute-state view in this set

personas.name: Anya
personas.verdict: A real order book with spread and tap-to-price is more than most wallet swaps give me, and resting limit orders on the account is a nice touch — but depth bars have no stated scale and fills history is thin.
blockers: 05-swap-bottom: bar basis (cumulative vs size) unstated, and no cumulative-depth curve for judging slippage on a 1 ETH order
07-activity: swap history shows 'Swap filled' with no amount or price on the row; I can't reconstruct my fills without opening each one
05-swap: no visible price-impact or effective-price-after-fee figure for a market-size order

personas.name: Ravi
personas.verdict: 'Enforceable right now' plus Export CSV and Save evidence bundle is closer to board-grade proof than anything I use today, but the proof export path is scattered across three screens.
blockers: 07-activity: Export CSV exists but signed-proof export lives on 15-sovereignty ('Save evidence bundle') and per-payment proofs on 03-receipt/08-activity-detail — no single 'export proof package for period X' flow
14-ownership: 'Lazy (hash of its board)' governance language gives me no confidence explaining entity control to a board
Large-sum check: no screen shows a per-account exposure table at a glance on mobile without scrolling lane by lane

personas.name: Sofia
personas.verdict: Creating a request and getting a PAID receipt with a proof hash is exactly my dream flow, but forwarding that receipt to a client is not one tap and the request screen talks like a protocol doc.
blockers: 04-receive/04-receive-bottom: three copy actions (invoice, link, xln:// app link) with no guidance on which to send a client
08-activity-detail: receipt sheet has no visible Share/forward button; Copy receipt exists only on the 03-receipt variant
04-receive-bottom: 'YOUR ENTITY ID' and 'account route to you… inbound room' are jargon she must translate for clients

personas.name: Kenji
personas.verdict: Per-frame dual signatures, proof hashes, co-signed accounts, and a one-tap evidence bundle are the real thing; I just can't see the dispute/challenge lifecycle itself in this set.
blockers: 15-sovereignty: shows 'they answer in 1 d, you in 1 d' but no dispute initiation wizard, challenge countdown, or evidence-bundle verification view is present (Dispute button on 06-account is the only entry point shown)
09-settings-bottom: Reveal recovery phrase adjacent to Forget vault with no visible confirmation step undermines the otherwise strict posture
03-receipt: 'Verified by your runtime' claims verification without a link to the raw frames for independent checking

personas.name: Lena
personas.verdict: Home → Pay → amount → Pay button is fast and thumb-reachable, and the receipt closes with one big Done — but a few cramped rows force reading, not glancing.
blockers: 02-pay: delivery/route details add scroll before the Pay button; under time pressure at checkout I want Pay above the fold after entering an amount
01-home-bottom / 06-account: ~11px legend and capacity text fails one-handed glanceability
04-receive: giant QR pushes share actions below the fold when showing it to a cashier

personas.name: Marcus
personas.verdict: Lane rows with credit line, collateral, and send/receive capacity are a legitimate desk view even on mobile; the color legend is exactly how I think about exposure.
blockers: 06-account: no aggregate exposure across counterparties on mobile — I must open each hub; the cross-hub desk table is referenced in Settings ('Desk is the dense console') but not shown in this set
06-account-bottom: send/receive capacity numbers (0.01 / 0.00) sit next to credit lines without a formula hint; I derived the relationship but a pro view should state it
13-lend-bottom: pool stats are all zeros with no counterparty risk laddering

personas.name: Fatima
personas.verdict: There is an 'Across networks' swap toggle with a multi-hop route and an explicit fee, which is promising, but nothing in this set shows me the cross-chain leg actually completing or its total cost.
blockers: 05-swap: the 'Across networks' mode is never shown — all swap screenshots are 'Same network'; the cross-network quote, bridge hop, and combined fee screen is missing from the set
02-pay: route hops (H3) are shown but there is no indication of per-hop time or failure handling for a two-network path
12-assets-bottom: the fallback receive actions ('USDC to my on-chain wallet', 'USDC straight into my reserve') hint at cross-venue movement but are unordered and unexplained

personas.name: Dmitri
personas.verdict: In three minutes I understood the differentiator — instant bilateral settlement with signed frames and a hard on-chain enforceable floor — and the Sovereignty screen alone sells the safety story.
blockers: 01-home: the hero balance is 75% 'Hub promise'; without tapping into Manage/Sovereignty the first screen could read as an unbacked IOU wallet
14-ownership: 'Lazy (hash of its board)' and 'take control of another entity' read as unfinished internals at the exact moment I judge polish
12-assets: all-zero balances with enabled buttons and 'Depository may pull 0.00' phrasing is the weakest first-impression surface in the product
